content.title: What steps can I take to reduce my water bill amount?
content.summary: The City partners with Resource Central to offer several outdoor water saving programs: Low-water garden plants (Garden in a Box) Lawn replacement Smart Controller sprinkler system upgrade Waterwise yard seminars Additionally, read these outdoor watering tips or watch this video.
